task_definition.task_description: Please look up headphones in electronics, check what coupons are available for me, and prepare an invoice recommendation for one Sony XM5 using PayPal and sending it to alice@company.com. Then place an express checkout order for the silver Sony XM5, and after that generate the invoice for that item using my available coupon and email it to alice@company.com with PayPal payment.

user_input.query: Hi, for user_id default_user, please look up headphones in the electronics category and show me up to 10 results. Also check what coupons are available for me, including coupon_code SAVE15. Then prepare an invoice recommendation for quantity 1 of one Sony XM5 using paypal and send it to alice@company.com. After that, place an express checkout order for the silver Sony XM5, and then generate the invoice for that item using my available coupon and email it to alice@company.com with paypal payment. Please include product_id p_sony_xm5_blk in the request details.
